channel.title: Booked: First Day In
channel.desc: The SWAT team responds to a call from Mesa County police to apprehend two wanted subjects, while a young woman in Virginia Beach receives an unexpected Mother's Day gift in the form of a new mugshot; in Flagler County, a young man learns the hard way that Florida's cannabis laws are more stringent than those in many other states.
